sparkline.$comment: One series drawn small, in a table's cell or a card (0117). Its own tier and not the chart's: a component tier may not point at another component's token, and a sparkline that took the chart's colours through them would re-theme with every chart override.

fg.$description: The drawing: the line, the bars and a band's on-slots, unless the consumer gives a colour.

width.$description: The width of the line, kept whatever the box is stretched to.

area-alpha.$description: How much of the drawing's colour fills the area under the line.

band-bg.$description: A band's off-slot: the surface's own shade.

dot-size.$description: The width of the dots on the last value and on the extremes.

dot-fg.$description: The dots, unless the consumer gives a colour.
